parameters.query: SELECT c.content_id,c.client_id,c.source_message_id::text,c.status,c.title,c.subtitle,c.cta,c.caption,c.hashtags,c.image_prompt,c.visual_description,c.assembly_instructions,c.automatic_response,c.ai_provider,c.ai_model,c.briefing,c.request AS intent,c.structured_output,v.id::text AS version_id,v.version,v.version_label,v.generated_image_path,b.logo_path,(b.primary_colors || b.secondary_colors) AS palette,COALESCE(b.preferences->>'default_template_id','') AS template_id,COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key='art_renderer'),'local') AS renderer,ro.render_id::text AS existing_render_id,ro.status AS existing_render_status,ro.final_art_path AS existing_final_art_path,ro.layout_spec_path AS existing_layout_spec_path,ro.checksum_sha256 AS existing_checksum FROM social_media.content_items c JOIN social_media.content_versions v ON v.content_id=c.content_id AND v.version=1 JOIN social_media.clients b ON b.client_id=c.client_id LEFT JOIN social_media.render_outputs ro ON ro.version_id=v.id WHERE c.content_id=$1 LIMIT 1;

WITH render_started AS (INSERT INTO social_media.render_outputs(content_id,version_id,template_id,renderer,source_image_path,final_art_path,layout_spec_path,status) VALUES($1,$2::uuid,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,'CREATING_ART') ON CONFLICT(version_id) DO UPDATE SET template_id=EXCLUDED.template_id,renderer=EXCLUDED.renderer,source_image_path=EXCLUDED.source_image_path,final_art_path=EXCLUDED.final_art_path,layout_spec_path=EXCLUDED.layout_spec_path,status='CREATING_ART',error_message=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE social_media.render_outputs.status IN ('CREATING_ART','FAILED','LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED') RETURNING render_id), content_updated AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET status='CREATING_ART',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 AND status IN ('IMAGE_GENERATED','CREATING_ART','ART_RENDER_FAILED','LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED') RETURNING client_id,source_message_id), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(m.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),c.client_id,$1,e.event_type,'05 - Orquestrador de Render Inicial',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'template_id',$3,'renderer',$4) FROM content_updated c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id CROSS JOIN (VALUES('ART_RENDER_STARTED'),('LAYOUT_RESOLUTION_STARTED')) e(event_type) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM social_media.events old WHERE old.content_id=$1 AND old.event_type=e.event_type AND old.details->>'version_id'=$2) RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::text AS version_id,(SELECT render_id FROM render_started LIMIT 1)::text AS render_id;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({content_id:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.content_id,version_id:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.version_id,version_label:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.version_label,client_id:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.client_id,template_id:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.template_id,renderer:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.renderer,title:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.title,subtitle:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.subtitle||'',cta:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.cta||'',source_image_path:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.generated_image_path,logo_path:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.logo_path,palette:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.palette,output_path:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.output_path,layout_spec_path:$('Preparar Render Inicial').first().json.layout_spec_path}) }}

parameters.query: WITH ctx AS (SELECT c.content_id,c.client_id,c.source_message_id,c.title,c.subtitle,c.cta,c.caption,c.hashtags,c.image_prompt,c.visual_description,c.assembly_instructions,c.automatic_response,c.ai_provider,c.ai_model,c.briefing,c.request AS intent,c.structured_output,v.id AS version_id,v.version_label,m.correlation_id,m.channel FROM social_media.content_items c JOIN social_media.content_versions v ON v.id=$2::uuid LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id WHERE c.content_id=$1), render_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.render_outputs SET template_id=$3,renderer=$4,source_image_path=$5,final_art_path=$6,layout_spec_path=$7,layout_spec=$8::jsonb,width=$9::int,height=$10::int,checksum_sha256=$11,status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL',error_message=NULL,rendered_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE version_id=$2::uuid RETURNING render_id), version_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_versions SET final_art_path=$6 WHERE id=$2::uuid RETURNING version_label), content_ready AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET current_version_id=$2::uuid,final_art_path=$6,status='READY_FOR_APPROVAL',updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING content_id), events AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,ctx.content_id,e.event_type,'05 - Orquestrador de Render Inicial',e.details FROM ctx CROSS JOIN LATERAL(VALUES ('LAYOUT_CREATED',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'layout_spec_path',$7,'template_id',$3)),('ART_RENDERED',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'width',$9::int,'height',$10::int,'checksum_sha256',$11)),('ART_READY_FOR_APPROVAL',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'final_art_path',$6,'layout_spec_path',$7))) e(event_type,details) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM social_media.events old WHERE old.content_id=ctx.content_id AND old.event_type=e.event_type AND old.details->>'version_id'=$2) RETURNING event_id), outbound AS (INSERT INTO social_media.messages(correlation_id,client_id,channel,direction,sender_id,body,raw_payload) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,COALESCE(ctx.channel,'demo'),'OUTBOUND','social-media-ai-agent','Preparei a arte solicitada. Segue a primeira versão para aprovação. Se quiser alguma alteração, é só me dizer.',jsonb_build_object('content_id',ctx.content_id,'version_id',$2::uuid,'version_label',ctx.version_label,'final_art_path',$6,'channel_adapter','demo') FROM ctx WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM social_media.messages om WHERE om.direction='OUTBOUND' AND om.raw_payload->>'content_id'=ctx.content_id AND om.raw_payload->>'version_id'=$2) RETURNING message_id), outbound_event AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,details) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,ctx.content_id,'OUTBOUND_CREATED','05 - Orquestrador de Render Inicial',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'final_art_path',$6,'message_id',(SELECT message_id FROM outbound)) FROM ctx WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbound) RETURNING event_id) SELECT ctx.content_id,ctx.client_id,ctx.version_id,ctx.version_label,'READY_FOR_APPROVAL'::text AS status,ctx.title,ctx.subtitle,ctx.cta,ctx.caption,ctx.hashtags,ctx.image_prompt,ctx.visual_description,ctx.assembly_instructions,ctx.automatic_response,ctx.ai_provider,ctx.ai_model,ctx.briefing,ctx.intent,ctx.structured_output,$5::text AS source_image_path,$6::text AS final_art_path,$7::text AS layout_spec_path,$9::int AS width,$10::int AS height,$11::text AS checksum_sha256,(SELECT render_id FROM render_ready) AS render_id,(SELECT message_id FROM outbound) AS outbound_message_id,true AS persisted,true AS demo_mode,false AS external_actions_executed FROM ctx;

WITH final_message AS (SELECT message_id FROM social_media.messages WHERE direction='OUTBOUND' AND raw_payload->>'content_id'=$1 AND raw_payload->>'version_id'=$2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), deleted AS (DELETE FROM social_media.messages WHERE direction='OUTBOUND' AND raw_payload->>'content_id'=$1 AND NOT (raw_payload ? 'version_id') AND message_id<>(SELECT message_id FROM final_message) RETURNING message_id) SELECT $3::jsonb AS result,(SELECT count(*) FROM deleted) AS consolidated_messages;

WITH ctx AS (SELECT c.client_id,c.source_message_id,m.correlation_id FROM social_media.content_items c LEFT JOIN social_media.messages m ON m.message_id=c.source_message_id WHERE c.content_id=$1), render_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.render_outputs SET status=CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,error_message=$3,updated_at=now() WHERE version_id=$2::uuid RETURNING render_id), content_failed AS (UPDATE social_media.content_items SET status=CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'ART_RENDER_FAILED' END,updated_at=now() WHERE content_id=$1 RETURNING content_id), event_created AS (INSERT INTO social_media.events(correlation_id,client_id,content_id,event_type,workflow_name,severity,details) SELECT COALESCE(ctx.correlation_id,gen_random_uuid()),ctx.client_id,$1,CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'ART_RENDER_FAILED' END,'05 - Orquestrador de Render Inicial','ERROR',jsonb_build_object('version_id',$2::uuid,'error',$3,'error_code',$4,'validation',$5::jsonb,'source_image_reusable',true) FROM ctx RETURNING event_id) SELECT $1::text AS content_id,$2::uuid AS version_id,CASE WHEN $4='LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' THEN 'LAYOUT_VALIDATION_FAILED' ELSE 'ART_RENDER_FAILED' END AS status,$3::text AS error,$5::jsonb AS validation,false AS persisted,false AS image_regenerated;
